notes.title: Patch Live! Improved controls and gamepad support!
notes.content:
Hello!

As promised, the new update is available. We have improved the controls, fixed some bugs and we have added support for gamepad!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/1da39e59e181290680c41a2e5d7aa61572acf2b9.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy the update. Let us know what you think at our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community Hub[/url].

[b]Have a great summer! And stay tuned for more news![/b]

notes.title: Release date set in Stone!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/72626fe618fc6c9d7ebcd54ede8e13aeb6725908.jpg[/img]

[h1]May 30th[/h1] 

On May 30th the game will be available and to celebrate its launch and thank everyone for their support on the [b]Greenlight[/b] campaign, it will be available at a [b]15% discount during its first week[/b] on Steam. 

In the mean time check out the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RMNywUAiUKA]announcement teaser[/url] and we will be really happy if you join us at our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community Hub[/url] and share your opinions and questions.

We hope you enjoy the game when released!
